context: Riku tells Aoi about a class that got cancelled.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (困っ/なくなっ/回っ/れれ/暇) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日の授業、急になくなったんだ。
lines.style: surprised teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: え、予定がなくなって困った?
lines.en: Huh, were you troubled the plan fell through?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 最初は困ったけど、暇ができたよ。
lines.en: At first I was stuck, but I got free time.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 暇な時間、何して回ったの?
lines.en: What did you do with your free time?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 街を回って、新しい店を見つけたよ。
lines.en: I went around town and found a new shop.
lines.style: happy teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 街も、どんどん進化してるね。
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 古い店がなくなって、少し寂しいな。
lines.en: It's a bit sad the old shops are gone.
lines.style: wistful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 暇な日に、また一緒に回ろうよ!
lines.en: Let's go around together again on a free day!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
